Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 2080 11 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 160 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in sound card
  • VR Support: None of them
  • Additional Notes: RTX only! Wanna play without raytracing - play the standard version, you can't even run this one without them.
